items.title: Vietnam in April 2027: Weather, Holidays & Where to Go
items.summary:
Limestone islands and calm green water in Ha Long Bay under a clear sky on an April morning 

April clears the winter mist off Ha Long Bay

 

## The short version

Weather: Hanoi 21 to 28°C, Hoi An and Da Nang 23 to 30°C with sea at 26°C, Saigon 26 to 35°C.

Best region: the central coast, which is at its best from April to June.

Holidays: Hung Kings Day on Friday 16 April 2027, then 30 April to 3 May (expected). Book domestic flights and beach hotels early for both. [...] Hanoi is warm and humid, around 21 to 28°C. Hue, Da Nang and Hoi An are dry and sunny, around 23 to 30°C, with the sea near 26°C. Ho Chi Minh City and the Mekong Delta are hot and dry, around 26 to 35°C. Sapa and Da Lat are mild, with cool evenings.

### Is April too hot for Ho Chi Minh City? [...] | Region | Day / night | What it's like | Verdict |
 ---  --- |
| Hanoi | 28°C / 21°C | Warm, humid, a few light showers | Good |
| Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh | 27°C / 21°C | Clearer skies, calm sea | Good |
| Sapa | 22°C / 13°C | Clear and mild, cool nights | Very good |
| Hue | 30°C / 22°C | Dry and sunny | Very good |
| Da Nang, Hoi An | 30°C / 23°C | Dry, sea about 26°C | Best |
| Nha Trang | 31°C / 24°C | Dry, calm sea | Very good |

items.title: Best Months to Visit Hanoi: A Complete 2026-2027 Guide
items.summary:
Winter in Hanoi, lasting from December to January, offers a stark and fascinating contrast to the tropical image of Vietnam. The weather turns dry, chilly, and occasionally misty, dropping temperatures to a level that requires a good jacket. However, the cold only adds to the city’s charm. It is the perfect season to wrap yourself in a scarf and explore Hanoi’s legendary street food scene, warming up over a hot bowl of Pho or a sizzling plate of grilled pork. For essential packing tips and [...] Hanoi winters (December–February) see temperatures of 10–20°C, with occasional drops below 10°C in January. It never snows, but the damp chill can feel sharp. Winter is absolutely worth visiting for foodies (hot phở, egg coffee, and hot pot are transcendent in the cold), atmosphere seekers (foggy mornings on Hoan Kiem Lake are hauntingly beautiful), and budget travelers (low crowds, low prices). Pack layers and lean into the coziness. [...] 🌡️ Avg. temp: 19–24°C | ☔ Rainfall: Low-Moderate (light mist) | 👤 Crowds: Low–Medium

» Hanoi Weather in March: Ultimate Travel Guide in Vietnam’s Capital

### April: Warm, Vibrant & Pre-Monsoon Perfect

April is another excellent month to visit Hanoi: temperatures climb comfortably to 23–28°C, skies are mostly clear, and the city hums with an energetic pre-summer buzz. It’s the last month before heat and heavy rain arrive, making it a sweet spot for outdoor exploration.

items.title: Vietnam in February 2027: Tet, Weather & What Closes | Day Trips Vietnam
items.summary:
It improves as you go south. Hanoi has historically averaged around 16-22°C with modest monthly rainfall but many drizzly, overcast days. Sapa is cold at roughly 8-14°C with more rain than the lowlands. Ha Long Bay runs around 15-21°C and is often misty. Hue sits near 18-25°C, Da Nang and Hoi An near 20-26°C, and both are far drier than in autumn. Ho Chi Minh City is hot and almost rainless at roughly 23-33°C, and Phu Quoc is warm, sunny and calm. These are historical averages, not forecasts. [...] Northern February is a month people consistently mis-forecast from a rainfall chart. Hanoi's monthly totals are genuinely low — historically in the tens of millimetres — but the number of days with something falling from the sky is high, because the north's late-winter signature is mua phun: a fine, persistent drizzle that dampens rather than soaks. Add near-permanent cloud cover and humidity that hangs around 70 percent, and you get a month that is comfortable in temperature (roughly 16-22°C) [...] | Da Lat | Around 12-24°C, dry season (roughly 10 mm) | Cool, clear, sunny |
| Hanoi | Around 16-22°C, low totals but many drizzly days | Mild but often grey |
| Ha Long Bay | Around 15-21°C, roughly 22 mm, frequently misty | Calm but hazy |
| Sapa | Around 8-14°C, roughly 80 mm, fog common | Cold and damp |

items.title: Dự báo thời tiết Hà Nội 10 ngày tới rét nhất 16 độ C
items.summary:
Theo tin thời tiết mới nhất từ Trung tâm Dự báo Khí tượng Thủy văn Quốc gia, không khí lạnh đã ảnh hưởng đến khu vực Tây Bắc Bộ, Bắc Trung Bộ và một số nơi ở Trung Trung Bộ.

Thời tiết Hà Nội hôm nay có mưa, nhiệt độ thấp nhất ở mức 15 - 16 độ C, độ ẩm 91%.

Theo dự báo thời tiết 10 ngày tới của Trung tâm Dự báo khí tượng thủy văn quốc gia, Hà Nội có xu hướng tăng nhiệt từ ngày 10.11, mưa dông có khả năng xuất hiện trở lại vào ngày 12 - 13.11. [...] Cụ thể, ngày 10.11, Hà Nội nhiều mây, không mưa, nhiệt độ thấp nhất 17 độ C, cao nhất 23 độ C. Gió đông bắc tốc độ 3 m/s.
